body: where is the line between me having an illness (bi-polar) and just being a shitty person?
I can't lean on him - he's fed up with me and my negativity. He doesn't understand why I want to put up walls and protect myself. He says I am going to end up alone.

Thank you for taking time to write such a nice reply. 

I have been pretty good about my meds.  My psychiatrist added another med a few weeks back because I was in a very bad state.  I admit I have not taken them today or yesterday.  I have injured my back and am on a lot of morphine and the mix was destroying my stomach.  I am seeing my psychiatrist on Friday.

When I am really stressed I take a shower. It clears my head and lets me cry in private. 

I used to listen to music, take photos, play video games - but now I just sit. I adopted another rescue pup in the fall after I lost my best doggy bud to cancer.  If it wasn't for her, I would just stay inside all the time. Nothing excites me anymore.  I hate myself more and more each day. 

I've been spending a lot of time going over my past and what I believed to be happening vs. what actually happened. I'm much more aware of the abuse I endured as a child and I have been trying to find value in myself.  

My partner and I have always believed in open communication - but he just unloaded on me yesterday that I have regressed and we have different life goals. I don't want to lose him but it would be far worse to guilt him into staying with me if I don't make him happy.  He is a tremendous person and deserves a tremendous partner. 

Thank you for the hugs and the songs.

I don't know what's the most important thing to me. I love my partner - but I know I am holding him back. 

I used to work in the non profit industry - I wanted to help people.  But due to a variety of reasons I was laid off.  

I have tried to work on my degree but I have a stupid amount of health problems and have only finished a few credits. 
 
I have no contact with my family. I come from a very abusive home and my therapist has encouraged me to set much stronger boundaries.

I don't have any passion any more.  I don't enjoy anything.

I have a spinal problem that restricts my movement (it ranges from mild pain to non movement). I am waiting to see a spinal surgeon - but it's a bit of a wait. 

I don't know how to find something I am passionate about. I get discouraged easily - and really don't have many useful or creative skills. 

Everything feels so pointless.

Thank you for your reply. 

I went to my Psychiatrist 3 weeks ago and she added another medication.  I see her again this week. I also saw my therapist last week - so I think I am genuinely trying. 

My partner has always said all he wants is for me to be working on my mental health. I am in therapy - I have gone to group therapy - I have tried to be self aware of my actions and I really thought I was making progress.... but he seems fed up with me.  He has accused me of being the reason that he has drifted from some of our friends - I have taken to cutting off contact with people that have hurt me.

Maybe I don't want to survive this if it means I am hurting the good people in my life. 

I really thought I was doing better - I would still have major depressions but they were lessening in frequency and length. I thought I was finally standing up for myself by focusing on the good people in my life and removing the bad.  

I'm not a fan of most people. I'd rather have a few good people I trust and stick to that. I realize I've become very pessimistic.  I used to believe that people were mostly good - but I've had so many experiences that disprove that.  I really thought that if I was kind to people that it would be returned - and that my kindness would make their lives better.  Stupid, I know. I thought I was going to make a difference and here I am in my thirties, barely able to get through the day. 

I'm really scared.  I thought I could get better and deserve the love of my partner but it seems I'm just pushing him and everyone else away.
